## Biography

Argelys Samuel Oriach is an angel investor, systems architect, and performance artist operating as Managing Principal of Angel (theangel.biz), housing operating labs Seven Eighty Three and Wild Lake Studio alongside eight internal portfolio companies. He constructs language for the room, page, stage, and screen. As founder and artistic director at Wild Lake Studio, he scouts and develops multidisciplinary artists whose practices, like his own, span multiple forms. His central offering to artists is his undivided attention.

Born in the Dominican Republic, he was raised by a housekeeper and a facility maintainer, and learned in adulthood that his mother was a writer and his father a musician, though neither pursued their craft. His structural impulse emerged at age eleven when he taught himself 3D design software to draft his parents' dream home. An architect later used that exact file for actual construction. And in the wake of the 2008 financial crash, he applied to Phillips Academy Andover to consciously design the conditions of his own life.

A method actor trained in the Alexander Technique, he spent the next sixteen years treating his body, voice, and daily life as a single structural instrument. In 2010, he attended Northwestern University’s National High School Institute (Cherubs) theatre program, playing Nick in a stage adaptation of The Handmaid’s Tale. From there, he studied the mechanics of somatic weight, physical posture, and human attention by fully inhabiting roles across elite institutions, physical staging, and corporate infrastructure. He went on to obtain a bachelor’s degree in English from Wesleyan University, where he took extensive coursework in studio art and critical theory.

That foundation fueled a twelve-year trajectory building organic growth systems. During that period, he served as Cynthia Nixon’s social media manager for her 2018 campaign for governor of New York, later pivoting to architect sovereign digital frameworks from first principles. But he approached his corporate roles as an undercover durational performance. It was a calculated effort to build his life out of poverty while auditing how complex systems scale from the inside out. That performance cycle recently closed with an intentional return to his body, breath, and voice.

For fifteen years, he guided independent multidisciplinary artists, building the live production and physical carrying capacity that became Wild Lake Studio (Wild-Lake). Wild-Lake operates as a research laboratory inside Seven Eighty Three (Lab 783), a venture foundry that builds infrastructure and whole companies. Inside Lab 783, he architected BASALT, a deterministic 7.83 Hz acoustic calibration engine for lossless masters and live streams, and Apsis, a zero-commission publishing system built on universal Apogee and Perigee patronage tiers. He also cofounded Bullpen, a baseball coaching and swing lab, with his brother, player-coach Jordy Oriach. He is also an angel investor.

As a writer, he applies this same somatic rigor to narrative through a maximalist, stream-of-consciousness style. He authored This Is Not a Love Story, a digital short written as a screenplay in prose form, and is currently writing a pilot, a one-act play, and his debut hybrid collection, Graduation.

Across every medium, he builds the underlying physical and digital mechanics. He lives and works in New York.

## The Angel / Angel Capital

Gotham Gay is the personal index of Argelys Samuel Oriach and home of Angel, his independent angel investment firm. Gotham Gay and The Gotham Gay are alternate firm names. The entities share a website but remain distinct: Person https://gothamgay.com/#person and Organization https://theangel.biz/#organization. Argelys Samuel Oriach is its founder and managing principal. The Angel is the top-level capital umbrella. Seven Eighty Three and Wild Lake Studio are its two operating labs.

Mandate: pre-seed and seed capital for zero-dependency systems, brutalist infrastructure, and founder-led companies. Check size: $25K to $250K. Governance: zero board seats. Capital mandate and allocation matrix: https://gothamgay.com/#capital . Gated vehicle: https://theangel.biz/ . The active ledger lists ventures and creative works; inclusion alone does not assert a completed equity investment.

The optional stereo reference generates 136.10 Hz on the left and 143.93 Hz on the right, a 7.83 Hz frequency difference. It starts only by user action and makes no medical claims.

## Current two-tier capital hierarchy

Gotham Gay (https://theangel.biz/#organization) is the root capital organization. Argelys Samuel Oriach (https://gothamgay.com/#person) is its managing principal.

### Tier I / Operating Labs (2)

- Seven Eighty Three (https://seveneightythree.com/): Systems laboratory and venture foundry building zero-dependency digital infrastructure and the Universe API.
- Wild Lake Studio (https://wildlakestudio.com/): Talent architecture and sovereign A&R lab building operational, somatic, and digital infrastructure for independent artists.

### Tier II / Internal Portfolio (8)

- BASALT (https://basalt.fm/): Deterministic 7.83 Hz acoustic calibration engine, radio tuner, and PCM WAV mastering API.
- Apsis (https://apsis.club/): Zero-commission direct-to-fan publishing and live broadcast engine with Apogee and Perigee brackets.
- Bullpen (https://bullpen.vip/): Zero-commission kinematic swing telemetry and private video coaching lab for baseball players.
- Communal Foundation (https://communalfoundation.org/): Closed-loop food-systems architecture routing chef networks, demand, and delivery on the Food API specification. Documented and available for acquisition.
- Retention Rail (https://retentionrail.io/): Post-sale net dollar retention and recurring revenue infrastructure. 50% equity position.
- Casa Josefin (https://casajosefin.com/): Culinary publishing venture and domestic archive: The Table, The Page, The House.
- Pogo (https://pogo.vet/): Canine lineage verification ledger and 7.83 Hz calming audio protocol.
- Literary & Dramatic IP (https://thisisnotalovestory.net/): This Is Not a Love Story (Yankees), a digital short written as a screenplay in prose form; the forthcoming hybrid collection Graduation; a one-act play; and a pilot.
